messages:
Dana R.: Heads up: security advisory — two coordinated changes that require action from infra and platform teams by next Friday EOD. 1) Rotate any long-lived internal service tokens older than 45 days. 2) Deprecate user-managed SSH certs for bastion access; all human/system access must use short-lived PKI-issued certs (ttl <= 24h). Details + helpers: https://intranet.redwood/sec/credential-hygiene :warning:
Noah H.: Can you paste the command to find old tokens? I'll run it across our clusters.
Dana R.: Run the secret inventory audit: `python tools/secret_audit.py --type=service-token --age=45` it returns service account keys and locations. We also published a rotate-helper for common services: https://intranet.redwood/sec/rotate-helper
Priya S.: For services already on Vault with leases, are we considered compliant?
Dana R.: If the service uses our managed token-service (token-service v2) or Vault with automatic lease renewal and short leases (<30d) you're compliant. Manually minted static tokens are in-scope. If you rely on an ad-hoc renew script, plan to switch to the managed renewer.
infra-bot: secret-audit job started (scope: eng, infra).
infra-bot: secret-audit job completed: 34 matches found. Report: https://ci.redwood/jobs/secret-audit/17766
Liam C.: I pulled the report 1 matches are CI related, 8 are legacy k8s jobs, 5 are old service accounts in staging. I'll prioritize CI and staging tonight.
Ops-Bot: Reminder: bastion PKI enrollment window is open. Use `pki enroll --role bastion-user` to request cert. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/pki
Priya S.: Quick question: will rotate-helper emit an audit event we can reference for compliance?
Dana R.: Yes 1 rotate-helper posts a signed rotation event to our audit endpoint and returns an event ID. Save that ID in your change log.
Zoe M.: Ops will rotate the ci-agent tokens and provision PKI certs for the on-call squad. ETA Thu EOD.
Noah H.: Dev infra will handle model-ingest and realtime-encoder. If anything breaks after rotation we'll open a rollback and tag @eng-oncall.
Dana R.: Thanks. Action checklist: - Run secret_audit and rotate any matching tokens (use rotate-helper where supported). - Migrate any bastion SSH access to PKI-issued short-lived certs. - Record rotation event IDs in your deployment notes. Please ack here when your team completes work. If you hit blockers, ping #eng-oncall and mention @Dana R. We may grant brief exceptions for critical rollout blockers but avoid them. :lock:
Noah H.: Acked. Starting scan now.
Liam C.: Acked.
Priya S.: Acked, will post event IDs when done.
